title: Last week's route plan as a complete or a partial hint

blocks.text: A courier firm re-plans its weekly delivery routes with a MIP: a binary $`y_r`$ per candidate route $`r`$, 1 if the route runs this week. Most weeks look like the last one, so the planners want to start the solver from last week's plan.

Write `hint_params(y, chosen, complete)`, which returns a `mathopt.ModelSolveParameters` holding one `SolutionHint` built from last week's plan. `y` is a dict from route name to its binary variable; `chosen` is the set of route names that ran last week.

items: `complete=True`: every route gets a value, $`y_r = 1`$ for $`r`$ in `chosen` and $`y_r = 0`$ otherwise.
`complete=False`: only the chosen routes get a value, $`y_r = 1`$; the solver fills in the rest.

blocks.text: One test solves with your parameters and reads HiGHS's log, as lesson 4.3.3 did; the others read the hint back. About five lines.

cases.says: a complete hint of last week's plan is accepted by HiGHS as a MIP start, as its log says
a partial hint holds every chosen route at 1, in one hint
a complete hint gives every route a value, 0 for routes not chosen
a partial hint has no value for any route not chosen

origin.section: A Hint Is a Starting Plan, Passed in `ModelSolveParameters`

concepts: a previous plan turned into a complete or a partial solution hint inside model parameters
